title: JWT Authentication Token Handler
description: Implement a cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 JSON Web Token (JWT) generator, verifier, and refresher. Protects against secret length vulnerabilities, timing attacks, 'alg: none' attacks, and token tampering.

methods: generate_token(user_id: str, roles: list[str], expires_in_seconds: int = 3600) -> str

constraints: Secret key must be at least 16 characters long.
Must explicitly reject unsecure algorithms such as 'none'.
Must use constant-time comparison (hmac.compare_digest) to prevent timing side-channel attacks.
Must enforce strict expiration timestamp validation.
verification_criteria: Valid token encodes correct claims and verifies without error.
Tampered payload or signature raises InvalidSignatureError.
Expired token raises TokenExpiredError.
Malformed or non-3-part token raises MalformedTokenError.

title: REST API CRUD Serializer & Validator
description: Implement a schema validator and serializer for User entities. Enforces RFC-compliant email formatting, alphanumeric username bounds, UUIDv4 identifiers, and immutable field protection on partial updates.
constraints: Username must be 3-30 alphanumeric characters (underscores allowed).
Email must conform to standard RFC email regex format.
Role must be one of: 'admin', 'editor', 'viewer'.
Field 'id' and 'created_at' must be immutable and rejected during partial_update.
verification_criteria: Valid user dictionary passes validation and serializes to valid JSON.
Invalid emails, usernames, or unauthorized roles raise ValidationError with specific field errors.
Attempting to modify 'id' or 'created_at' in partial_update raises ValidationError.

title: High-Throughput Rate Limiting Sliding Window
description: Implement an efficient in-memory sliding window rate limiter that handles bursty microsecond-precision requests, returns remaining quota and retry-after latency, and evicts stale historical logs.

methods: is_allowed(key: str, max_requests: int, window_seconds: float, current_time: Optional[float] = None) -> tuple[bool, int, float]

constraints: Must accurately track request timestamps within the moving window [current_time - window_seconds, current_time].
Remaining requests must accurately decrement down to 0.
When rate-limited, retry_after_seconds must accurately return the seconds until the oldest request in the window expires.
cleanup_expired must safely purge stale client records to prevent memory leaks.
verification_criteria: Permits requests up to max_requests within the moving window.
Blocks requests exceeding quota and provides accurate retry_after_seconds.
Sliding window slides continuously rather than resetting at fixed boundaries.
cleanup_expired frees memory for inactive clients.

title: Directed Graph Cycle Detector & Topo Sort
description: Implement a cycle detection and dependency resolution engine for directed graphs using 3-color Depth-First Search (White/Gray/Black). Detects circular dependencies, extracts cycle paths, and produces topological orderings for DAGs.
constraints: Must correctly detect self-loops (e.g. A -> A) as cycles.
Must handle disconnected subgraphs and multi-component graphs.
topological_sort must return a valid dependency ordering if acyclic, and None if cycles exist.
Cycle paths returned must start and end at the same node.
verification_criteria: Detects simple cycles (A -> B -> C -> A) and self-loops.
Returns None for topological sort on cyclic graphs.
Produces valid topological order on complex DAGs where all dependencies precede dependents.

title: Clean Billing Service & Idempotent Payment
description: Refactor legacy nested-callback spaghetti billing into a clean, testable, object-oriented billing service with domain models, coupon calculations, tax rounding, and idempotent payment processing.

methods: calculate_total(items: list[InvoiceItem], coupon: Optional[DiscountCoupon] = None, tax_rate: float = 0.0) -> float
process_billing(customer: Customer, items: list[InvoiceItem], coupon: Optional[DiscountCoupon] = None, payment_gateway: Any = None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None) -> PaymentResult

constraints: Money totals must round strictly to 2 decimal places.
Percentage discounts apply before tax; fixed discounts apply before percentage.
Expired coupons or coupons failing minimum spend must raise ValueError.
Must prevent duplicate billing using the idempotency_key.
verification_criteria: Subtotal, discounts, and taxes calculate accurately without floating-point precision loss.
Invalid or expired coupons are rejected.
Re-submitting the same idempotency_key returns cached success without re-charging the gateway.

title: Concurrent Async Data Fetcher with Retries
description: Refactor slow sequential blocking HTTP requests into a non-blocking asyncio concurrent fetcher with bounded concurrency (asyncio.Semaphore), per-request timeouts, and exponential backoff retries.

methods: async fetch_url(url: str, timeout: float = 5.0, max_retries: int = 2) -> dict
async batch_fetch(urls: list[str], max_concurrency: int = 5, timeout: float = 5.0) -> list[dict]

constraints: Must enforce concurrency limits using asyncio.Semaphore so active requests never exceed max_concurrency.
Must implement retry logic on transient network or 5xx server failures.
Batch fetch must not fail completely if a single URL fails; return individual status objects.
verification_criteria: Concurrent execution finishes significantly faster than sequential execution.
Semaphore strictly limits simultaneous in-flight requests.
Retries transient errors and records permanent failures gracefully.

title: Unit & Property Test Suite for Order FSM
description: Implement a finite state machine managing e-commerce order lifecycles (CREATED, PAYMENT_PENDING, PAID, FULFILLING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, REFUNDED) alongside an embedded property and invariant test suite.

methods: transition(event: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> None

constraints: Cannot transition out of terminal states: DELIVERED, CANCELLED, REFUNDED (except DELIVERED -> REFUNDED).
Attempting an illegal transition must raise IllegalTransitionError and preserve current state.
State transition history must be immutable and record timestamps.
verification_criteria: Valid transitions succeed and advance the state.
Illegal transitions raise IllegalTransitionError without mutating state.
Terminal state rules are strictly enforced.
History contains complete chronological transition records.

title: Thread-Safe In-Memory Cache with RLock
description: Debug and fix race conditions, dirty reads, and cache stampedes in a concurrent in-memory cache using threading.RLock and atomic get-or-compute semantics.

methods: get(key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any
set(key: str, value: Any, ttl_seconds: Optional[float] = None) -> None
get_or_compute(key: str, compute_func: Callable[[], Any], ttl_seconds: Optional[float] = None) -> Any

constraints: Must synchronize read-modify-write operations using a re-entrant lock (RLock).
Expired keys must be cleaned up lazily or on access and not returned.
get_or_compute must invoke the compute_func exactly once even under high concurrent thread contention.
verification_criteria: Survives 50+ concurrent reader/writer threads without KeyError, corruption, or deadlock.
TTL expiration purges stale data correctly.
get_or_compute executes compute function only once during concurrent cache misses.

title: Robust Subarray Prefix & Sliding Window Max
description: Debug and eliminate classic off-by-one errors in prefix sum range queries, sliding window maximums, and binary search range bounds.

methods: prefix_sum_query(arr: list[int], queries: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> list[int]
binary_search_bounds(sorted_arr: list[int], target: int) -> tuple[int, int]

constraints: prefix_sum_query queries are inclusive [left, right]; must handle left == 0 and right == len(arr) - 1 properly.
sliding_window_maximum must correctly handle window size k == 1, k == len(nums), and k > len(nums).
binary_search_bounds must return (first_occurrence, last_occurrence) inclusive, or (-1, -1) if target is missing.
verification_criteria: Prefix sums calculate exact inclusive ranges without index errors.
Sliding window maximum handles empty lists, k=1, and all boundary transitions.
Binary search bounds finds exact duplicate span indices in O(log n) time.

title: Webhook HMAC Verifier & Replay Guard
description: Implement a secure webhook ingestion pipeline with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, replay attack prevention via timestamp tolerance checking, and structured event dispatching.

methods: register_handler(event_type: str, handler: Callable[[dict], Any]) -> None
verify_signature(payload: bytes, signature_header: str, timestamp_header: str, current_time: Optional[float] = None) -> bool
dispatch(payload: bytes, signature_header: str, timestamp_header: str, current_time: Optional[float] = None) -> dict

constraints: Signature scheme: HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + payload).
Must reject requests with timestamp drift exceeding max_drift_seconds (default 300s).
Must use constant-time comparison (hmac.compare_digest) for signature verification.
Must return structured result with status SUCCESS, INVALID_SIGNATURE, or EXPIRED_TIMESTAMP.
verification_criteria: Valid signatures within tolerance dispatch to the registered handler.
Replay attacks with timestamps > 300 seconds old are rejected.
Tampered payloads or wrong secret keys fail signature verification.
